message: not applied: `{card}`; this analysis is not available
description: The deck asks for an analysis this simulator does not have (such as `.four`, `.tf`, `.sens`, `.pz`, `.disto`, `.pss`, `.hb`, `.sp`), so it is not run. The analyses available are `.op`, `.dc`, `.tran`, `.ac` and `.noise`.
actions: Derive the quantity from an available analysis: a transfer function from `.ac`, Fourier components from the `.tran` output.
Remove the card if you only need the other analyses in the deck.
